# VA Beauty Studio

> Beauty salon in Palma de Mallorca (Ponent): manicure, pedicure, technical pedicure (pain-free nail and foot care), nail extensions and facial treatments. The team speaks Ukrainian, Spanish, English, German and Russian.

- Address: Carrer Albó 2, local 3, Ponent, 07013 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain
- Phone and WhatsApp Business: +34 684 301 949 (https://wa.me/34684301949)
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday 10:00–18:00; closed on Sunday
- Booking: online form on the website, WhatsApp or phone; every appointment is confirmed personally
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/va_beauty_studio__/

## Services and starting prices

- Manicure: from €35 — without polish women €35 / men €40; regular polish clear €40 / colour €45; gel polish €60; gel strengthening S/M/L €65/€70/€75
- Pedicure: from €55 — without polish women €55 / men €65; regular polish €60; gel polish €65
- Technical pedicure (Pedicura técnica): from €25 — full technical pedicure €55, with gel polish €65, men's €50, hard skin and cracked heels €35, thickened nails €30, technical nail cut €25
- Nail extensions: S (0–1) €70, M (2–3) €75, L (4) €80
- Additional services: French tips €10, chrome powder / stamping €5, simple hand-painted nail art €10, detailed nail art €15, spa treatment (scrub + nourishing candle or spa gloves) €15, paraffin €10
- Nail shape restoration: from €10 (depending on length); gel and gel polish removal
- Lifting & rejuvenation: from €85 (microneedling with Dermapen, microcurrent, carboxytherapy)
- Hydration & glow: from €65 (needle-free mesotherapy, personalised facial programmes)
- Cleansing & balance: from €55 (Hydrofacial, combined facial cleansing, ultrasonic peel)
- Skin renewal: from €80 (chemical, enzyme and glow peels, micro-exfoliation)
